server.name: io.github.streaik/Microsoft-OutlookMail
server.title: Microsoft Outlook Mail
server.description: Read recent inbox message summaries using delegated Microsoft Graph access.

resources.name: my-latest-emails
resources.title: My latest emails
resources.description: Retrieves the 15 most recent emails from the user's Inbox, including subject, sender, received time, and read status.

resources.name: my-contacts
resources.title: My contacts
resources.description: Shows the first 10 personal contacts with name, email addresses, and mobile number.

resources.name: unread-emails
resources.title: Unread emails
resources.description: Retrieves the 10 most recent unread emails from the user's mailbox with subject, sender, and time.

resources.name: my-mail-folders
resources.title: My mail folders
resources.description: Lists the mail folders in the user's mailbox (like Inbox, Sent, Drafts, Archive, etc).

resourceTemplates.name: search-email
resourceTemplates.title: Search email
resourceTemplates.description: Search emails using a name, email address, or keyword with optional filters for status, importance, flagged, or attachments. Use 'searchQuery' for keyword and 'filterQuery' for advanced filtering.

resourceTemplates.name: emails-from-folder
resourceTemplates.title: Emails from folder
resourceTemplates.description: Get the 10 most recent emails from a specified mail folder (e.g. Inbox, Sent, Archive), optionally filtered by any property such as attachments or status.

resourceTemplates.name: attachments-of-email
resourceTemplates.title: Attachments of an email
resourceTemplates.description: Get metadata for up to 10 attachments of a specified email by message ID, including name, size, and type.

resourceTemplates.name: search-contacts
resourceTemplates.title: Search contacts
resourceTemplates.description: Search personal contacts by name, company, or other field, returning up to 10 results.

resourceTemplates.name: single-email-details
resourceTemplates.title: Single email details
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieve the full details and body content of a specific email by message ID, including recipients, attachments, and the complete message body.

resourceTemplates.name: outlook-drafts
resourceTemplates.title: Outlook draft messages
resourceTemplates.description: List draft messages and their IDs so a file attachment can be added or removed.

resourceTemplates.name: outlook-mail-folder-details
resourceTemplates.title: Outlook mail folder details
resourceTemplates.description: Get a mail folder by ID before copying or organizing messages.

prompts.prompt: For the sender {emailAddress}, summarize all unread emails from the past {days} days: include the main topics, the number of emails, and any detected urgency or follow-up actions.

template.name: sender-unread-summary
template.title: Sender unread summary
template.description: Summarizes unread emails from a specific sender in a time window, highlighting topics, volume, and possible urgency.

arguments.name: emailAddress
arguments.description: The email address of the sender.

arguments.name: days
arguments.description: The number of past days to include in the summary.

prompts.prompt: Review my last 10 flagged emails and suggest three actionable follow-ups. For each, briefly describe the email and recommend the most urgent next step.

template.name: flagged-emails-followup
template.title: Flagged emails follow-up
template.description: Analyzes recent flagged emails and proposes concrete next actions for each.

prompts.prompt: List my unread emails with attachments from the past {days} days. For each, summarize the sender, subject, and suggest if the attachment needs urgent review.

template.name: unread-attachments-review
template.title: Unread attachments review
template.description: Helps the user quickly scan and prioritize unread emails with attachments for a recent time window.

arguments.name: days
arguments.description: Number of days in the past to review.

prompts.prompt: Analyze my recent sent emails to {recipientName} and suggest if there are any open threads or required follow-ups, including missed replies or pending attachments.

template.name: sent-emails-followup
template.title: Sent emails follow-up
template.description: Scans recent sent emails to a specific recipient for unfinished conversations or missing actions.

arguments.name: recipientName
arguments.description: The display name or email address of the recipient.
